# Browser Automation Extension

> A Chrome Manifest V3 browser-automation extension with a Node.js backend that delegates navigation decisions to OpenAI.

## Project documentation

- [README](./README.md): setup, usage, architecture, and scripts.
- [Agent guide](./AGENT.md): coding rules and quality commands.
- [Contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow.
- [Security](./SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting.
- [Privacy](./PRIVACY.md): data processing and permissions.
- [Support](./SUPPORT.md): help channels.

## Key directories

- [Backend](./backend/): API and automation-decision service.
- [Extension](./extension/): Chrome extension source.
- [Design system](./design-system/README.md): UI tokens and component guidance.
